title: Ramirez Do These
text:
What? I like to play Modern Warfare 2.

To shed some light to this, there's this meme called "Ramirez Do Everything", where Sgt Foley commands Pvt Ramirez to do things. And by things, I mean anything. Destroy a tank with rubber bullets, stop a nuke with a riot shield, and even make Foley a sandwich.

Oh, and I have no idea what category this GIF is supposed to be.

title: Carturian Strut
text:
These creatures are omnivores that feed primarily on the carturia grape plant to which the Carturian Strut's name derives. They obtain a toxin from these grapes and are capable of channeling a potent dye to their feathered shoulder blades.
Carturian Struts prance around with a wide galloping strut. The bright colorful feathers are used in both mating displays and to ward off larger predators, warning them that their blood and flesh are poisonous.

This was an updated revision.

title: Gift to the Gods
text:
Hello guys,

It is a piece I did for a contest held by 3dtotal.com (amazing site, btw!). I did it very quickly because I found out the challenge two days before the deadline. I had pretty good idea of what I want to paint and what kind of mood I want to achieve. 

The good news is that this painting WON! I am so shocked, because I have seen so many great pieces there! Amazing! I was jumping around my room when I checked the result page For more visit: www.3dtotal.com and click March Challenge results for more information and the rest of winning pieces. The competition was hard as it was merged between 2d and 3d!

Here is a WIP: [link] I hope you can view images at the forum.

His gift to the gods is his pain and struggle. Title: Mutilation

Best,
Mateusz
